{"data":{"id":"608600","key":"RTS-49747","fields":{"summary":"No Results Found After Search Export","description":"

Hi Support,

 

Can you please raise a ticket for AS Watson on the below issue.

 

AS Watson are using a Search which contains a Reference Search and when they try to export – it provides ‘0 Results’. I believe this is a known issue in 5.3 when creating a data export for a Search that uses a Referenced Search.

 

Please can this be reviewed?

 

Thanks

Kelly

 

 

Kelly Regan
EMEA Client Services Consultant

Hi Team,

 

Thank you for getting in touch. As mentioned by Kelly, there is a known issue in the current Secure version.

We can confirm the new version 5.4 has resolved this issue.   

 

Let us know if there is anything further in the meantime.

 

Regards,

 ** 

Natasha Fabricante
Program Manager

","updateAuthor":{"accountId":"6100625aec92ab0070676c11","emailAddress":"tolugbenga@apprissretail.com","displayName":"TOlugbenga@apprissretail.com","active":false,"timeZone":"America/New_York","accountType":"atlassian"},"created":"2020-02-03T12:11:47.957-0500","updated":"2020-02-03T12:11:59.148-0500","jsdPublic":false},{"id":"626308","author":{"accountId":"6100625aec92ab0070676c11","emailAddress":"tolugbenga@apprissretail.com","displayName":"TOlugbenga@apprissretail.com","active":false,"timeZone":"America/New_York","accountType":"atlassian"},"body":"

Thanks Natasha

 

@Sospeter Gitau (Superdrug - Security Analyst) – the workaround option would be to export the two separate Searches to excel in the meantime and use V-Look up.

 

Let me know if you wish to discuss on our call tomorrow.

 

We do not yet have a date for 5.4 – the next release is 5.3. We will communicate a date as soon as this becomes available.

 

Thanks

Kelly
